Package lu.kbra.pclib.datastructure.list

Class LinkedArrayList<T>

java.lang.Object
java.util.AbstractCollection<T>
java.util.AbstractList<T>
lu.kbra.pclib.datastructure.list.LinkedArrayList<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of elements in this list
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable, Iterable<T>, Collection<T>, List<T>, DeepCloneable
public class LinkedArrayList<T> extends AbstractList<T> implements Cloneable, DeepCloneable
A list backed by a linked chain of dynamically growing arrays (blades). Each blade holds at most m elements. Removing elements does not shrink the underlying arrays or rebalance the blades.

Time complexity:

Operation Average Worst
get(index) O(b) O(b)
set(index, value) O(b) O(b)
add(value) O(1) amortized O(m)
add(index, value) O(b + m) O(b + m)
remove(index) O(b + m) O(b + m)
size() O(1) O(1)
clear() O(1) O(1)
trimToSize() O(n + b) O(n + b)
pack() O(n * m) O(n * m)
compact() O(n * m) O(n * m)
  • n - Total number of elements in the list (size()).
  • m - Maximum number of elements per blade (maxBladeSize).
  • b - Current number of blades in the list.

When fully packed, the number of blades is b = ceil(n / m). After deletions, partially filled blades may increase b.

Example: With n = 1000 and m = 256, the list requires b = 4 blades when fully packed (256 + 256 + 256 + 232 elements).

Indexed access traverses the blades sequentially. Appending is amortized constant time. Indexed insertion and removal may require shifting up to m elements within a blade.
